A confirmed diagnosis requires confirmatory bacteriological testing such as sputum smear microscopy, Xpert MTB/RIF, or culture [who-tb-screening-01]. Prompt referral for confirmatory testing is crucial because delays increase transmission risk [who-tb-triage-refer-01].
raw_payload.recommendation: If a patient has a positive screening result, refer them immediately for confirmatory testing, such as sputum smear microscopy, if Xpert MTB/RIF is unavailable [who-tb-triage-refer-01]. For indeterminate or borderline results, use clinical judgment; if symptoms persist, proceed directly to sputum testing [who-tb-triage-retest-01].
